title: plugin-calendar: `calendar-view`'s `colorMapping` input is declared but inert — nothing reads it, so an authored colour map does nothing
body:
Measured while producing #4453's forwarded-prop census (every key `calendar-view`'s renderer could carry, and where it lands). `colorMapping` is the one declared input with no read site at all.

## The declaration

`packages/plugin-calendar/src/calendar-view-renderer.tsx`, the registry metadata:

```ts
{
  name: 'colorMapping',
  type: 'object',
  label: 'Color Mapping',
  description: 'Map field values to colors (e.g., {meeting: "blue", deadline: "red"})'
}
```

Published as `calendar-view` schema API in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx` too (`colorMapping?: Record< string, string >`).

## The read site

There is none. The renderer's event mapping takes the colour straight off the record:

```ts
const colorField = schema.colorField || 'color';
…
color: record[colorField],
```

`grep -rn colorMapping packages/plugin-calendar/` returns exactly one hit: the declaration above. `CalendarView` has no such prop either — it resolves a colour from `event.color` (`resolveEventColor`). So an author who writes the documented `colorMapping: { meeting: 'blue' }` gets no mapping, no warning and no error: the raw field value is used as the colour, which for a picklist value like `meeting` is not a colour at all.

Before #4453 the key rode the renderer's `{...props}` spread into `CalendarView`, which does not declare it, so it was dropped there; after #4453 it is dropped at the renderer boundary. Neither is a behaviour change — the key has never done anything.

## Same class as #4454

#4454 is the twin on the same widget (`allowCreate` declared, the handler it would drive built and never passed). Filed separately rather than as a sub-issue because the fixes are disjoint: `allowCreate` needs `onAddClick` wired, `colorMapping` needs a lookup in the events memo (or the declaration retired). Both are instances of "declared authorable surface with no implementation behind it", which is the enforce-or-remove question — worth deciding once for this widget rather than twice.

## Fix shape (needs the same enforce-or-remove call)

1. **Implement**: `color: colorMapping?.[record[colorField]] ?? record[colorField]` in the events memo, plus a pin. Cheap, and it makes the documented example work.
2. **Retire**: drop the input and the doc line, on the grounds that no measured app authors it.

No `pm:queue` decision implied either way — recording the measurement so the next agent on this widget does not have to re-derive it.
